description: Lua script for processing admonitions and HTML elements for different output formats, including handling callout admonitions, HTML details/summary tags, and formatting for LaTeX and Markdown outputs.

methods.name: Div
methods.description: Handles callout admonitions and wraps content in LaTeX boxes based on classes and output format.

methods.name: RawBlock
methods.description: Processes HTML details and summary tags, converting them to LaTeX or Markdown depending on output format.

methods.name: RawInline
methods.description: Strips HTML inline elements when not outputting to HTML.

methods.name: Para
methods.description: Formats paragraphs inside summaries to be bold in LaTeX.

methods.name: Plain
methods.description: Formats plain text inside summaries to be bold in LaTeX.
